annual_reference: The listed benefits and allowances describe the approved monthly plan. Annual pricing and benefit quantities are not configured.
rules: Memberships are intended for eligible, approved business sellers/providers.
Job-posting credits are issued after a verified successful billing cycle.
Each job-credit batch expires 90 days after issuance.
Valid unused job credits roll forward until their individual expiry.
Credits are consumed from the earliest-expiring batch first.
Monthly marketing benefits reset according to the applicable billing cycle.
Unused creative designs, campaigns, AI video allowances, and social advertising credits do not roll forward.
Social advertising credits are not cash and cannot be withdrawn.
Outdoor advertising and billboard placements require separate quotations.
Additional marketing services beyond included allowances are separately chargeable.
Membership benefits do not guarantee leads, bookings, advertising performance, or sales.
Membership activation and benefit issuance require verified successful payment.
Payment subscriptions are not yet available in the current public interface.
Annual pricing has not been approved or configured.
